comment: Longitudinal health data may arise from clinical research and specimen collection as well as routine care. The architecture should recognise this without allowing research data to be reused for care or public-health purposes without an appropriate legal and ethical basis.

anchor.note: p.157 l.98–102 read as the printed page

public.text: Longitudinal health data may arise from clinical research and specimen collection as well as routine care. The architecture should recognise this without allowing research data to be reused for care or public-health purposes without an appropriate legal and ethical basis.
public.suggestedRevision: Include authorised clinical-research and biobank systems as possible sources, subject to ethics approval, participant consent choices, purpose limitation and applicable national law.
